          assert d['fresh_oos'] is False
          assert d['parameter_bundle_sha256']=='07abe29e31ce09b69bd6250b1ce3ebc5af7688b69ed39909feb80e9db882aaa0'
          assert d['validation_window']=={'start':'2026-01-05','end':'2026-08-21'}

          assert d['scaler_refit_performed'] is False
          assert d['feature_selection_performed'] is False
          assert d['hyperparameter_search_performed'] is False
          assert d['threshold_search_performed'] is False
          assert d['probability_calibration_layer_fit_or_applied'] is False
          assert d['trading_return_used'] is False
          assert d['post_2026_08_21_rows_loaded'] is False
          assert d['raw_2026_rows_written_to_repo'] is False
          assert d['source_hashes']['local_annotated_panel']=='4619b00670b9443d0c0de7dd8a3a7a2d664a3c8907f28b0f997c9ae737cae216'
          assert d['source_hashes']['local_datahub_1m']=='307e48021ef4576c2b364a1309a8b0474d6ab783afee16be41edb975abaa6dcd'
          assert usage['role']=='repeat_only_not_fresh'
          assert usage['post_2026_08_21']=='not_loaded_true_fresh_reserved'
          assert usage['model_refit_performed'] is False
          assert usage['parameter_search_performed'] is False
          print(json.dumps({
            'decision': d['decision'],

          git config user.email 'gap-fill-v2-repeat-cloud-runner@users.noreply.github.com'
